headline: Morning wash: a light lather on a wet face
subhead: Pour an appropriate quantity into wet hands, rub into a light lather, massage into face; rinse thoroughly.
footnote: 4.1 out of 5 stars from 2,732 reviews on beminimalist.co, captured 2026-10-02
layout_description: Left column: large strength figure and active name, then headline, subhead and up to three proof points; the AI-generated person scene (person_prompt) is the human cue and carries the AI-GENERATED — ILLUSTRATIVE mark top-right; real pack shot composited in the right 45%; rating line in the footnote band, CTA bottom-left.
image_prompt: Empty background scene only: a bright morning bathroom wall in off-white tile with a soft frosted-window light shape on the left and a gentle shadow towards the lower right. Off-white, soft natural light, few props, clinical minimal style. Square 1080x1080. Keep the right 45% of the frame as an empty clear space, evenly lit, reserved for a pack photo placed later, and keep the left 50% calm and low-detail, reserved for copy added later. No product, no bottle, no packaging, no text, no letters, no logos, no people, no faces, no skin, no hands.
adaptation_notes: Angle: situation. The moment is a morning wash before the day starts, which matches the page's 'AM & PM, every day' (F14) and the lather-and-rinse steps (F13); no result is implied. Kept: in-use moment (Foxtale), headline that names one use moment (Chemist at Play). Dropped: timed-fix headline, '#1 daily duo', and all sebum, acne-fighting and pore-decongestion wording from F2/F3/F5. The person is AI-generated (High risk, labelled); a real application photo would lower the risk. Rating in the footnote slot.

person_prompt: A woman in her early 30s with a medium-brown skin tone at a bathroom basin on a weekday morning, hair clipped up and a shirt collar visible, wet hands lathering a light white foam between her palms before washing her face; bright soft daylight from the upper left through a frosted window, plain off-white tile behind, shallow depth of field, brisk but calm expression, natural unretouched skin, nothing implying a result, framed so she sits slightly left of centre with calm space to her right. No product, bottle, pump, tube or packaging anywhere in frame; no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names.
